desc: Read input N, Q, array A, and queries (u, v).
Precompute factorials and their modular inverses up to N.
Precompute prefix sums for $A[i]$ and $A[i] \cdot i^{-1}$ to answer queries in $O(1)$.
Process each query using the derived formula: $Ans = \text{total\_trees} \times 2 \times \left( \frac{1}{v} \sum_{i=2}^u A[i] - \sum_{i=2}^u \frac{A[i]}{i} \right)$.
Print the results for all queries.
